_comment: Prices READ OFF the live TejasMex configurator (design.tejasmex.com/?dealer=Columbia)
on 2026-08-27 via scripts/probe-tejasmex.js. These are the vendor's own itemised
estimate values, not anything this repo computed. They are the acceptance oracle:
if lib/pricing disagrees with a number here, lib/pricing is wrong.
All amounts are CHARGED (post-surcharge) dollars, as displayed.

components.note: A 6x6 roll-up (garage-door-1-gable, list 670) added exactly 670 to an enclosed 24x25x9 (8128 -> 8798). Components are NOT surcharged.

_comment: Totals are exactly base + cert + leg + 2*side + 2*end, so walls are plain
additive line items. Side walls span the LENGTH, end walls span the WIDTH.
Side wall price varies with BOTH length and width; end wall varies with width
(constant across length at a given width).

rows.caveat: legs read 725 because the leg type had drifted to double-legs; base/side/end are still valid

notes: No certification line at all: engineer-certified widthTags cover 12-30 only.
Base 9998 is FULL LIST - the -10% surcharge rule is capped at width 30.
A mandatory Skytrack Lift Flat Fee is added AFTER subtotal in its own
'Service Fees' category, which the engine does not yet model.
Legs 805 is the double-legs ladder, auto-selected at this width.

notModelled: Enclosed wall prices: side/end values above are measured, but the underlying rule is not decoded and 662/763/2545 appear NOWHERE in the 5.35MB vendor payload - they are computed client-side.
Service Fees category (Skytrack lift) and its width trigger.
Widths over 30ft: leg-height bands cover 12-24 and 26-30 only.
Lean-tos, colours/premium colour tiers, gauge/brace/truss/frame-spacing/roof-pitch deltas, storage and tack rooms.
